strategy.offer: Managed cloud communication services for secure business messaging, integration, security, archiving, file exchange, and electronic document workflows across multiple channels.
strategy.customers: Businesses, public institutions, and channel partners needing reliable, compliant, high-volume communications in critical or regulated processes across industries.
strategy.why_we_win: The firm argues it wins through reliable, secure, globally available services, easy integration, flexible service levels, transparent usage-based pricing, and continuous innovation.
strategy.resources: Its basis is messaging expertise, proprietary data centers, developed interfaces, technical and support teams, partner enablement, and sustained research and development investment.
strategy.direction: It is heading toward more innovative enterprise messaging that supports digital business processes, better customer experience, and broader global, multichannel cloud adoption.
